subject: Fermi GRB 260529A: Global MASTER-Net observations report
submitter: Vladimir Lipunov at Moscow State U/Krylov Obs <lipunov@xray.sai.msu.ru>
body:

A.R.Corella, L.H.Rodriguez (INAOE, Guillermo Haro Astrophysics Observatory) 

MASTER-OAFA robotic telescope  [1]  located in Argentina (OAFA observatory of San Juan National University) started inspect of the Fermi GRB 260529A ( Fermi GBM team, GCN 44733) errorbox  564 sec after notice time and 606 sec after trigger time at 2026-05-29 03:00:04 UT, with upper limit up to  17.5 mag. The observations began at zenith distance = 74 deg. The sun  altitude  is -66.9 deg. 

The galactic latitude b = -25 deg., longitude l = 28 deg.


Real time updated cover map and OT discovered available here: 
https://master.sai.msu.ru/site/master2/observ.php?id=3345808

We obtain a following upper limits.  

Tmid-T0  |      Date Time      |          Site       |             Coord (J2000)          |Filt.| Expt. | Limit| Comment
_________|_____________________|_____________________|____________________________________|_____|_______|_______|________

     666 | 2026-05-29 03:00:04 |         MASTER-OAFA | (20h 10m 08.98s , -15d 23m 33.3s) |   C |   120 | 17.3 |        
     807 | 2026-05-29 03:02:10 |         MASTER-OAFA | (20h 10m 09.05s , -15d 23m 24.1s) |   C |   150 | 17.5 |        
Filter C is a clear (unfiltred) band. 


The observation and reduction will continue. 
The message may be cited.
